### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **28** documentable anchor(s).

**20** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b4f69716e72ea6a962cecd144bdcbe89581d85c3`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **6** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **172** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b4f69716e72ea6a962cecd144bdcbe89581d85c3` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `91292014c736b4efca62e8f34a7ab804890d86bd` — the merge of head `b0a1b1df63ad92b4ebc66e09ec664d07c0961c89` into base `b4f69716e72ea6a962cecd144bdcbe89581d85c3`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 91292014c736b4efca62e8f34a7ab804890d86bd && git checkout 91292014c736b4efca62e8f34a7ab804890d86bd
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin b4f69716e72ea6a962cecd144bdcbe89581d85c3 b0a1b1df63ad92b4ebc66e09ec664d07c0961c89 && git checkout -B drift-repro b4f69716e72ea6a962cecd144bdcbe89581d85c3 && git merge --no-ff b0a1b1df63ad92b4ebc66e09ec664d07c0961c89

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b4f69716e72ea6a962cecd144bdcbe89581d85c3
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs b4f69716e72ea6a962cecd144bdcbe89581d85c3` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `495824e8cb1318626f97b22629d910c5933376a7`
Local-runs: none
Scope: hits — `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-readonly-field-written-by-live-flow-refused.ts`, the `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` declaration (PR body + `.changeset/32666-object-write-judges-live-flows-readonly.md`); implementing/enforcing — `packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts`, `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-gate.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-publish-batch.ts`, and the six test files of the diff (read as pins).

Read, not reviewed: card #32666 and all 14 comments (dev report 6824221584, analysis 6824493421, ruling 6837273204, claim 6838067592 / re-post 6838719903, os-dev report 6839881159), the seat order, the PR body, `contract-review.md`. Outside the diff, read only: `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` / `buildRuntimeWriteSnapshotSet` (stored-self pass, #22118), `mergePendingDeclarations`, `collectBatchPendingDeclarations`, `publishPackageDrafts` docblock (all-or-nothing), `validate-preset-comparands.ts`, the object-door roster pin. Nothing was run; every statement below is from reading the head tree, and the dev's test, gate and ablation numbers are quoted, not re-measured.

### ① Derived judgments

- Condition 1 — met. Member declares `runtimeTypes: ['flow', 'object']` (`reference-integrity-suite.ts:770`), the spelling `validateObjectFieldRefs` has (`:453`); roster pin updated (`runtime-gate.object-writes.test.ts`). Differential untouched (`runtime-gate.ts:1375-1400`): flows sit in baseline, stored and candidate, so a conflict the stored universe holds cancels. Pins: lint `runtime-gate.object-readonly-flow-writes.test.ts:114`; door `protocol-publish-drafts-closure.test.ts:789` (broken state made through `OS_ALLOW_UNLINTED_METADATA_WRITES`, then a label edit publishes).
- Condition 2 — met in wording, with one false sentence. Docblock reworded (`runtime-gate.ts:306-326`), field doc `:401-418`. False positives: dev reports 0 added findings over 34 objects / 45 flows / 68 writes, 4/4 positive controls (not re-run). The sentence "every other write type is handed none, so nothing else judges them" (`:318-319`) is not true on the object write itself — see ④-2.
- Condition 3 — met. `protocol-publish-drafts-closure.test.ts:759` (flow elevated and published first, then field readonly, publishes clean), plus the one-batch form `:774` and lint `:102`.
- Condition 4 — met in form. PR body and changeset both carry `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` / `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, the `adr-0087: registered` marker, BREAKING banner, migration line, minor ×3. D3 entry has the five-field `SemanticMigration` shape of its neighbours (`18.wait-node-event-config-required.ts`). Spelling not re-run here; the dev's `check-changeset-no-major` / `check-adr-0087-registration` exit 0 are quoted. The declared TEXT is incomplete — see must-fix 1.
- Scope 6 — holds. Host reads flows on `singular === 'object'` only, inside the existing `Promise.all` (`protocol-authoring-gate.ts:425-427`), filtered by `_packageId` (`flowsOfWrittenPackage`, `:523`). A flow write drops any `flows` context (`runtime-gate.ts:914`) and keeps `flows[0]` (`:1177`); `objectWriteFlowSubjects` returns `undefined` for every type but `object` (`runtime-authoring-gate.ts:878`). The two amended files are the forced rows (`runtime-authoring-gate.ts:745`, `protocol-publish-batch.ts:216`) plus the object-write context; no other write type's inputs change. Cost: +1 `sys_metadata` read per active object write, +1 `repo.get` per flow draft in EVERY batch (also batches with no object draft); not measured.
- Out-of-scope 7 — hook/action bodies untouched; other packages filtered and pinned (`closure.test.ts` "a flow of ANOTHER package"); pre-existing conflicts not charged.
- 5(b) — sound. A flow redrafted WITHOUT the fix is judged on its own flow write against the batch's objects (pending objects stay folded for non-object writes), where baseline has no flows, so the finding is always charged; the batch is all-or-nothing (`protocol.ts` `publishPackageDrafts` docblock, ADR-0067 D2 / #32396), so the object does not stay live. If the pending read degrades to `undefined`, nothing is subtracted — the strict direction. No hole found. Not pinned at the door for the "live flow redrafted unfixed + object readonly" shape (nit).

### ② Semver level

minor with BREAKING banner is the right level for an accept-set narrowing of the runtime object write doors (AGENTS.md: level follows the metadata protocol; `narrowed` ⇒ minor). `RuntimeStackContext.flows?` and `nameKeyFindingPath`'s third parameter are additive and optional. No major. The level stands; the declaration's description of WHAT narrowed does not cover the whole diff (must-fix 1, should-fix 2).

### ③ Boundary flags

- `packages/spec` change is one data-only D3 entry; no schema, no runtime logic.
- `domain:server` half (`packages/metadata-protocol`) is declared in the claim re-post 6838719903 and stays inside gate wiring.
- PR author as seen through the relay is the fleet bot; body attribution names `os-elon-musk`. No off-relay write observed.
- Option C (#32861) not built.

### ④ Design judgment

1. 5(a) is correct for the ruled case and wider than the ruled case. `ruleObjects` (`runtime-authoring-gate.ts:1357-1359`) leaves the written object's draft out whenever `objectWriteFlows !== undefined`, and the host hands flows (possibly `[]`) on EVERY object write (`protocol-authoring-gate.ts:425`, `:486`). So at publish-drafts the stored self of every object update changes from its own draft to its live body, for ALL rules of the object door, not for the flow subjects only. On `origin/main` the folded draft made `stored` equal `candidate`, and `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` cancels every stored-pass finding located on another entry (`runtime-gate.ts:1383-1393`) — the dev's own A7 and PR text say "every finding the write adds on another entry cancelled". After this diff, publish-drafts newly refuses an object draft that breaks a LIVE sibling: a detail's `lookupColumns` naming a column the master draft drops (`validateObjectFieldRefs`, the #22118 (b) case, today pinned only through `saveMetaItem`), `related-list-group-not-body` on a stored parent (#27478), an RLS policy reading a membership key the draft drops (#25234, located on `permissions[...]`), roll-ups. This aligns the batch door with the live save and is the better behaviour, but it is an accept-set narrowing the ruling does not name, the changeset and D3 entry do not declare, no test pins, and the census did not measure (the census counted findings added by flows through `runRuntimeAuthoringRules`, not sibling findings through the batch fold).
2. A second rule judges the carried flows. `validatePresetComparands` (gating, on the object door) walks `flows` (`validate-preset-comparands.ts:217`) and binds a CRUD node's filter to `config.objectName`; an object write that retypes a field to `date`/`datetime` while a live flow filters it by a bare preset name now adds an error on the flow and refuses the object write. The ruling admits flows for `flow-update-readonly-field` (and `-when`); `validateStackExpressions` fences itself (`validate-expressions.ts:2783`), this rule does not. The PR's acceptance notes mention it; the changeset, D3 entry and docblock (`runtime-gate.ts:318-319`) do not.
3. 5(b), the name-key rule and `SUBJECT_ONLY_CONTEXT_KEYS` are the right shape: one differential, no per-rule exemption, flow-write wire unchanged.
4. Package boundary: a tenant overlay write with no package (`sys_metadata` sentinel) meets only package-less flows, so locking a field of a PACKAGED object through an overlay is not judged against that package's flows. Inside the ruling's bound; worth one sentence in the D3 entry.

Implemented-by: card thread session_016WV4cyHr6StnLZNnnjngzY
Reviewed-by: domain:spec#3 seat (CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER subagent)

Verdict: FAIL

- must-fix 1 — undeclared, unpinned narrowing at `POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts` (④-1). Either (a) confine the draft exclusion so only the flow-subject judgment sees the live stored self, or (b) keep it and make it a declared part of this narrowing: state it in the changeset and the D3 entry (or a second entry), pin one non-flow sibling case at the batch door in both directions (master draft drops a column a live detail's `lookupColumns` names ⇒ 422; label-only master draft with a pre-broken detail ⇒ publishes), measure it on the shipped corpus, and put it before the maintainer as exceeding ruling A's text. Derived by reading; one probe on `origin/main` vs head confirms or refutes it.
- should-fix 2 — `validatePresetComparands` judges carried flows on an object write (④-2). Fence it (as `validateStackExpressions` does) or declare and pin it; correct `runtime-gate.ts:318-319` either way.
- nit 3 — no door pin for "live flow redrafted unfixed + object made readonly in one batch ⇒ batch refused, flow named".
- nit 4 — cost line: the per-flow-draft read is paid by every batch holding a flow draft, not only batches with an object; say so.
- nit 5 — D3 entry: name the overlay / other-package limit (④-4).

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `13c704fec3c27c098404b91b30f3683bedd49a61`
Local-runs: none
Scope: hits — `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-readonly-field-written-by-live-flow-refused.ts`, the `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` declaration (PR body + `.changeset/32666-object-write-judges-live-flows-readonly.md`); implementing/enforcing — `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`, `packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts`, `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-publish-batch.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-gate.ts` (unchanged in the delta, re-read), and the two test files of the delta (read as pins).

Delta round on record 6839975695 (FAIL at `495824e8`: must-fix 1, should-fix 2, nits 3-5). Judged: `git diff 495824e8 13c704fe` (9 files, +321/-54), and the net diff against `origin/main` wherever the delta touches it. Read, not reviewed: ruling 6837273204, the updated PR body, `contract-review.md`, `execution-duties.md:78-80`, `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:158-168`, `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md:215-221`, issue #32832, PR #32736. Nothing was run; the dev's probe, test counts, census and ablations C1/C2/F1/F2 are quoted, not re-measured.

### ① Derived judgments

- must-fix 1 — closed. The host hands the full fold as `context.objects` again (`runtime-authoring-gate.ts:1375`), as on main; the fold without the written draft exists only as `subjectObjects` (`:1360-1362`, `:1381`), and only when the carried flow set is non-empty. In the gate the ordinary differential is built from `withoutSubjectCollections(args.context)` (`runtime-gate.ts:1280-1286`, `:1434-1440`) and never reads `subjectObjects`; `subjectObjects` enters only `subjectContextFor` (`:1293-1305`). So every object-door entry judges main's objects and no flows. Residue against main: the snapshot carries an empty `flows: []` key (the builder iterates `CONTEXT_STACK_KEYS`, `:905-927`), present since round 1 and harmless to a rule that walks an absent collection as empty. Pin: door `protocol-publish-drafts-closure.test.ts:844` (master draft drops a column a live detail's `lookupColumns` names, live flow in the package ⇒ published); dev ablation C1 red.
- Ruling condition 1 on the subject differential — met. It reuses `addedFindings` (`runtime-gate.ts:1313-1349`), the same baseline / stored / candidate passes extracted verbatim from the old body, over a snapshot whose stored self is the written object's LIVE body. A conflict the tenant already holds appears in the stored pass on `flows[i]`, is located on another entry and cancels; a conflict another object draft of the batch causes appears in the baseline (that draft stays folded) and cancels on this write, and is charged on that draft's own write. Pins: lint `runtime-gate.object-readonly-flow-writes.test.ts:115`, `:176`; door pre-broken-tenant pin of round 1 unchanged.
- No double report, no contradiction. The ordinary pass still dispatches `validateReadonlyFlowWrites` on an object write but with no flows, so it emits nothing there; the subject pass runs one registry entry (`SUBJECT_PASS_ENTRIES`, `:1277`, `:1490`) whose suite skips every member without `subjects` (`reference-integrity-suite.ts:923`), i.e. runs that one member. The two passes have disjoint emitters, so their sets cannot overlap or disagree. Dev ablation F1 shows the doubling returns when the fence is removed.
- should-fix 2 — closed. Flows are absent from the ordinary snapshot, so `validatePresetComparands` (and `validateStackExpressions`) cannot reach them; pin `runtime-gate.object-readonly-flow-writes.test.ts:147`, member pin `:195`. The docblock (`runtime-gate.ts:318-327`) now describes the mechanism the code has and is true; the false sentence is gone.
- nit 3 — closed: `closure.test.ts:823` (object readonly + flow redrafted unfixed ⇒ refused, causal item the flow, `flows[0]…`).
- nit 4 — closed in code, not only in words: `protocol-publish-batch.ts:223`, `:232` skip the flow-draft read in a batch with no object draft, which returns that batch to main's reads (on main `flow` had no row and hit `if (!key) continue`). `pending.flows` has one reader, `objectWriteFlowSubjects` (`runtime-authoring-gate.ts:1349`).
- nit 5 — closed: the D3 entry names the same-package, package-less-overlay and hook/action limits (`18.object-readonly-…ts:23-26`).

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: minor ×3 with the BREAKING banner, by `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`. The delta removes an undeclared narrowing and adds none. New in the delta, all optional and additive: `ReferenceIntegrityRule.subjects` (`reference-integrity-suite.ts:200`), `ReferenceIntegrityRunOptions.subjectPass` (`:879`), `AuthoringRuleContext.subjectPass` (`authoring-rules.ts:364`), `runRuntimeAuthoringRules({ subjectObjects })` (`runtime-gate.ts:1418`). No major.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `packages/spec`: the delta edits only the D3 entry's prose; no schema, no runtime logic.
- `packages/metadata-protocol` half stays inside gate wiring; `protocol-authoring-gate.ts` is untouched by the delta.
- `SUBJECT_PASS_ENTRIES` is exported from the module for its pin only; it is not in `index.ts` or the `runtime` subpath, so it is not published surface.
- PR author through the relay is the fleet bot; attribution names `os-elon-musk`. No off-relay write observed. Option C (#32861) not built.

### ④ Design judgment

1. The mechanism is the confinement the seat asked for and is close to minimal: one member field, one context flag, one extra arg, one extracted helper. It keeps the round-1 properties (one differential shape, no per-rule exemption in the gate, flow-write wire unchanged) and replaces "trust every rule to ignore flows" with "no rule but the declaring one is handed them", which is the stronger guard for the next member that reads `stack.flows`.
2. Two looseness points, neither wrong today. `subjects` is declared as key names but the suite tests only non-emptiness (`:923`), so with a second subject key a member would run for a subject it did not declare. `SUBJECT_PASS_ENTRIES` matches a registry entry by string name; a rename would silently drop the subject pass, and only the refusal pins would catch it.
3. Public surface. Three of the four new members are reachable from the `@objectstack/lint` entry declarations (`index.ts:1036`, `:1205`, `:1233`; the fourth through `validateReferenceIntegrity`'s parameter), as round 1's `RuntimeStackContext.flows` is. Under `execution-duties.md:78-80` that is surface growth, and the in-tree spelling for "narrows and adds" is `yes (narrowing)` (`.changeset/25921-providers-upload-fold.md`). The declared `no (narrowing)` is the spelling ruling condition 4 fixes verbatim, the changeset body names `subjects` and `subjectObjects`, and neither tier, lane nor level would move. Accepted deviation, recorded as nit 1; the line's closing sentence "Nothing is widened." is true of the metadata accept set only.
4. `Skills-docs: none` holds as a verdict: the skills teach the rule, not an order of publishing, and the refusal carries the post-#32736 remedy (`validate-readonly-flow-writes.ts:382-387`; #32736 is an ancestor of the head). The stated reason is incomplete: the callout it leans on (`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:158-163`) still gives "Set `runAs: 'system'`" without the button limit, which is exactly the open follow-up #32832, while this PR's own migration line states that limit. The reason should cite #32832 (nit 2).
5. No new hole found in the delta. A degraded pending read leaves `subjectObjects` equal to the live objects, the strict direction. A flow draft adds `any = true` only in a batch that already holds an object draft, so no batch gains a fold it lacked.

Implemented-by: card thread session_016WV4cyHr6StnLZNnnjngzY
Reviewed-by: domain:spec#3 seat (CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER subagent)

Verdict: PASS

- nit 1 — `Clause-②` line: the delta adds optional members reachable from the `@objectstack/lint` entry (`subjects`, `subjectPass` ×2, `subjectObjects`). The ruled spelling `no (narrowing)` is kept as an accepted deviation; in the prose face, name `subjectPass` beside the other two and scope "Nothing is widened." to the metadata accept set.
- nit 2 — `Skills-docs: none` reason (PR body + changeset): cite #32832 for the button-start limit of `runAs: 'system'` instead of saying the skills already teach the remedy in full.
- nit 3 — `reference-integrity-suite.ts:923` tests `subjects` for non-emptiness, not for the carried key; tighten when a second subject key appears. Follow-up, not this PR.

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · PR #32952 · head `b0a1b1df63ad92b4ebc66e09ec664d07c0961c89` · 2026-11-13T02:31Z

- **形态:** 944 changed lines (+896/−48) in `packages/lint`, `packages/metadata-protocol` and one ADR-0087 D3 entry in `packages/spec`: on an OBJECT write, the runtime doors (package publish-drafts and the live save) carry the written package's live flows into a separate subject differential that runs only `validateReadonlyFlowWrites` (`flow-update-readonly-field` / `-when`), charging only findings this write adds; every other object-door rule judges exactly main's snapshot. Executes ruling A (6837273204), conditions 1–4. `check-governed-merges --pr 32952`: NOT governed, 944 ≤ 3000 → ordinary queue landing.

Round 3 `13c704fe..c5c41e4e` is the changeset only (3 lines), read by the seat: `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` naming the four optional `@objectstack/lint` fields reachable from the entry (`ReferenceIntegrityRule.subjects`, `ReferenceIntegrityRunOptions.subjectPass`, `AuthoringRuleContext.subjectPass`, the `subjectObjects` arg of `runRuntimeAuthoringRules`; seat call per execution-duties.md:78-80 surface growth, the review's nit 1), "Nothing is widened" dropped, `Skills-docs` cites #32832. Full dogfood battery on `13c704fe` (code byte-identical at `c5c41e4e`): 456 files / 3831 tests passed, exit 0. Census: 0 added findings over 34 objects / 45 flows, 4/4 positive controls. CI on `c5c41e4e`: 71 runs, 58 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed. K was 32 (≥ 15), so the seat ran ONE platform base-sync (relay `pr_update_branch`, `c5c41e4e` → `b0a1b1df`, main `b4f69716`): `git patch-id --stable` of the net diff is 8d3aaeda before and after, so every review record carries under the head-move exception. - **接受的偏差:** `Clause-②` reads `yes (narrowing)` where the ruling's condition 4 wrote `no (narrowing)`: the narrowing is the ruled one; the `yes` arm only declares the lint type growth the implementation needed (no new authorable key, no new behaviour beyond the ruling). `check-closing-target-claim` UNDETERMINED (thread branch outside `CLAIM_BRANCH_SHAPE`; claim 6841227564 names this seat). Residue vs main: an empty `flows: []` key in the object-write snapshot, harmless (6841160520 ①).
- **范围外去向:** review nit 3 (`reference-integrity-suite.ts:923` checks `subjects` non-empty, not that it carries the key) → recorded in the os-dev report's out_of_scope. Out of the ruling by its own text: hook/action bodies writing read-only fields, flows of another package, tenants already broken; option C is #32861. Skills: #32832 (open) carries the runAs `'system'` button limit.
- **落地条款:** `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, `@objectstack/lint` + `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` + `@objectstack/spec` minor, ADR-0087 D3 entry. Contract-review PASS on record, all items discharged, all checks green ⇒ ready + auto-merge now (not governed, no human approval owed). `Fixes #32666` (p0, `target:18.4.0`).

Seat opinion: land.
